ops.summary: List jobs
Create a job (booking). AIR_EXPORT auto-seeds 15 milestones; SEA_FCL_EXPORT auto-seeds 16 FCL milestones + sea_fcl_details. Set parent_job_id for a HOUSE job.
Soft-delete a completed or cancelled job
Get a job with air details, charges, milestones, and its house jobs (if a master)
Update a job (not allowed once COMPLETED or CANCELLED)
Update Air Export-specific booking fields (airline, HAWB/MAWB, flight, AWB type, freight type)
List bills of lading on a Sea FCL job
Create a bill of lading data record (PDF variants are Week 8)
Soft-delete a bill of lading
Update a bill of lading (draft → original / surrendered flags)
Cancel a job (status -> CANCELLED)
List FCL cargo lines on a job
Add an FCL cargo line (optionally assigned to a container)
Remove an FCL cargo line
Update an FCL cargo line
Calculate CFS storage: days × rate_per_day from sea-fcl-details
Add a charge line — Job P&L recalculates automatically
Remove a charge line
Update a charge line
Close a job (status -> COMPLETED)
List containers on a Sea FCL job
Add a container to a Sea FCL job
Remove a container from a Sea FCL job
Update a container on a Sea FCL job
Assign an existing cargo line to a container
Container fill indicator for one container
Record container return to shipping line
Split one container across multiple house consignees (co-loading)
Container fill indicators — weight % and CBM % for all containers
Update customs clearance workflow (PENDING→FILED→QUERY→CLEARED→RELEASED)
SI / VGM / CY cutoff traffic-light status (green / amber ≤24h / red past)
List damage reports
Create a damage report (description + photo URLs + survey #)
List customs / port deposits with expiry alert bands
Create a customs or port deposit record
Soft-delete a deposit
Update a deposit
List documents attached to a job
Register a document on a job (metadata + file URL)
Remove a draft document
Update a draft document metadata
Finalize a document (DRAFT -> ORIGINAL, locked)
Queue Back-to-Back BL PDF (master + house pair)
Queue barcode label PDF
Queue Cargo Arrival Notice (CAN) PDF and mark CAN_SENT
Queue cargo manifest PDF generation
Queue consignee label PDF
Queue Delivery Order PDF and mark DO_ISSUED
Queue E-AWB PDF generation
Queue Exchange Letter PDF
Queue FIATA FBL PDF
Queue freight certificate PDF
Queue Freight Manifest PDF (FCL)
List async document generation tasks for a job
Queue HAWB PDF generation (Puppeteer + BullMQ)
Queue HBL draft/original PDF (layout_variant: STANDARD | LAYOUT_A | LAYOUT_B)
Queue Non-Negotiable HBL Express/Telex Release PDF
Queue Job Card PDF
Queue job costing sheet PDF
Queue Job P&L Statement PDF
Queue MAWB PDF generation (Puppeteer + BullMQ)
Queue Master BL / OBL PDF
Queue pre-alert document PDF generation
Queue Pre-CAN (pre-arrival notice) PDF
Queue Proforma Invoice PDF for the job
Queue Proof of Delivery PDF
Queue Proxy BL PDF (proxy_forwarder_name / address)
Queue Rider/Addendum to BL PDF (pass rider_terms)
Queue Sailing Confirmation PDF (uses sailed_at / vessel sailed milestone)
Queue Shipping Advice PDF
Queue Shipping Instruction (SI) PDF
Queue Stuffing Report PDF from stuffing records + containers
Queue BL Surrender Notice PDF
Queue Switch BL PDF (switched_from_bl_number + switch consignee/notify)
Queue Transhipment Confirmation PDF
Queue Transport Request PDF
Queue Undertake Letter PDF
List per-container free days + demurrage/detention accrual (traffic light)
Upsert free-days / demurrage rates for a container
Recalculate demurrage + detention accruals for all containers on the job
List the house jobs consolidated under this master job
List all milestones for a job
Add a custom milestone outside the standard taxonomy
Update a milestone — set actual_date to mark it complete
List notes on a job
Add a note to a job
Remove a job note
Update a job note
List part deliveries
Record a part delivery (remaining balance auto-calculated from job pieces)
Create a payment request from job totals / parties
Job P&L breakdown — revenue lines, cost lines, GP summary (Ch.8.2)
List proofs of delivery
Record proof of delivery
Schedule a pre-alert email for a future UTC time (cron delivers it)
Send pre-alert and mark PRE_ALERT_SENT milestone complete
Distribute a master job's cost line to its house jobs, proportionally by chargeable weight
Update Sea FCL-specific booking fields (shipping line, BL numbers, cutoffs, VGM/SI)
Record SI submission (date + version) and mark SI_SUBMITTED milestone
Record VGM submission (date + SM1/SM2) and mark VGM_SUBMITTED milestone
List stuffing records on a Sea FCL job
Create a stuffing record and mark STUFFING_COMPLETED
Soft-delete a stuffing record
Update a stuffing record
List operational sub-jobs under this parent
Create an operational sub-job under this parent
Link this FCL Import job to an outbound SEA_FCL_EXPORT job
Send WhatsApp status stub (logged until WHATSAPP_ENABLED=true)

bl_type.description: HBL | MBL | FIATA | SWITCH | PROXY | BACK_TO_BACK | Express Release

milestone.description: Free-form milestone name, for anything outside the standard taxonomy.

is_cost.description: Cost line (to a supplier) if true; revenue line if false.

is_provisional.description: Provisional estimate — excluded from confirmed P&L until confirmed.

party_id.description: Supplier Party — only meaningful for cost lines.

file_url.description: Public or signed URL where the generated/uploaded file is stored.

parent_job_id.description: Set to create this as a HOUSE job under a master.

job_type.description: Defaults to the parent job type.

layout_variant.description: Template layout variant (e.g. STANDARD, LAYOUT_A, LAYOUT_B)

bl_id.description: Use a specific BillOfLading record; otherwise latest matching type / job defaults

number_of_originals.description: Number of original BLs shown on header (1–3)

conversion_factor.description: kg per CBM; IATA standard is 167.

bl_type.description: HBL | MBL | FIATA | SWITCH | PROXY | BACK_TO_BACK | Express Release

is_cost.description: Cost line (to a supplier) if true; revenue line if false.

party_id.description: Supplier Party — only meaningful for cost lines.

file_url.description: Public or signed URL where the generated/uploaded file is stored.

parent_job_id.description: Set to create this as a HOUSE job under a master.

actual_date.description: Actual completion date — set this to mark the milestone complete.
